confirmatory_of.disclosure: Every v1 quantity used here (eta ladder centers/shifts, the rho_eff estimator form, contested-curve selection) is pilot/calibration input from v1 and is disclosed as pilot-informed. No v2 outcome existed when this contract was registered. v2 uses fresh seeds throughout.
pilot_informed_registered_changes: H256 mu0 ladder shifted one sqrt2 rung down (v1 defect A: mu0.9-adjacent optima above/below v1 windows)
H256 mu0.9 ladder recentered upward per v1 pilot bracketing failure (defect A)
H64 mu0.9 ladder widened to explicit 2x spacing per v1 pilot bracketing failure (defect A)
gate rho is the noise-corrected effective persistence rho_eff from cross-worker cosines (v1 defect B: raw lag-1 projected cosine is noise-compressed)
analyzer control flow computes rho at every H from mu0 telemetry unconditionally on mu0.9 curve validity (v1 analyzer defect)
quantitative D_pred/D_obs ratios are reported descriptively and never gated

theory_positioning: Khaled et al. 2509.10439 Thm 2's 1/(1-mu) multiplier is the rho->1 limit of the registered filter law eta_eff=eta(1+mu/(1-mu*rho)); E1' discriminates them with corrected instruments.
objective: Confirmatory test of whether measured effective pseudo-gradient persistence (noise-corrected) replaces the rho=1 learning-rate multiplier, and whether the resulting outer-muP rule predicts tuned outer learning rates across horizon, worker count, and model scale.

eta_star_estimator.curve: loss=a*x^2+b*x+c fitted to the four seed-mean grid losses at the exact registered eta values (supports the registered 2x-spaced H64 mu0.9 ladder)
eta_star_estimator.interior_rule: a>0 and vertex -b/(2a) strictly inside the numeric grid
eta_star_estimator.unbracketed_rule: nonpositive curvature or boundary/outside vertex is UNBRACKETED
eta_star_estimator.divergence_rule: any required nonfinite/missing seed cell makes the curve invalid rather than excludable

seed_ci.method: paired nonparametric seed bootstrap, refitting eta_star each replicate
seed_ci.interval_scale: log2 eta or log ratio as appropriate

rho_estimator.name: noise_corrected_effective_persistence_v2
rho_estimator.pilot_basis: v1 defect B (outer-mup-v1-closure.md): raw lag-1 projected cosine is noise-compressed and is not a valid estimator of effective rho
rho_estimator.source: mu=0 telemetry at the eta grid point nearest pooled eta_star(mu=0); computation MUST be independent of mu0.9 curve validity (v1 analyzer defect)
rho_estimator.cross_worker_statistic: c = fragment-balanced cross-worker mean pairwise exact cosine (cross_worker.mean_cosine, worker_count 4, all 6 pairs defined)
rho_estimator.aggregation: mean within fragment, then mean across the four fragments, then mean across the five primary seeds (identical to v1 aggregation)
rho_estimator.lags_2_4: registered diagnostics and AR1-adequacy report; never gated

spearman.method: ordinary Spearman rank correlation with midranks for ties (n=4 exact test, as v1)
